caption:
Consumer sentiment hit a 3-month high. 📈

The University of Michigan's early November survey came in at 51.0, up from 48.0 in October. Year-ahead inflation expectations eased from 4.7% to 4.3%.

Still a low number, but the mood is moving the right way.

Does your wallet feel better than a month ago?
